title: Prime binomials without a root are irreducible in any characteristic
statement: Let $F$ be any field [def-weil-field], $p$ a prime number and $t\in F$. If there is no $u\in F$ with $u^p=t$, then $X^p-t\in F[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] is irreducible: it is a nonzero nonunit and every factorization has a unit factor. There is no assumption on the characteristic of $F$.
